title: 第十五章复仇开始第十六章击杀龙凤楼掌柜
content_zh:
就在秦风因为自己的突破而沾沾自喜时。
突然，一股恐怖的凶威从哀山深处扩散出来，让众多强大的凶兽们，纷纷匍匐跪地，瑟瑟发抖。
正在和龙战战斗的凶鸟王也不敢大意，急忙停战，转身看向哀山深处的方向，坠落跪地，脸上神情无比恐惧！！
“不好！”
“是那股强大的气息，莫非是哀山至尊苏醒了？？”
龙战脸色剧变，不敢有丝毫大意，连忙踏空离去！！
此时的他，已经顾不了太多，满脑子里只有跑路这一个念头，要是被这位哀山至尊给逮住了，后果不用多想，必死无疑！！
好在，这股强大的凶威虽然散发了出来，但却并没有任何杀意，反倒是很快便消失全无。
这让刚刚逃离哀山范围的龙战，不由松了一口气。
可当他看见哀山外面的景象时，脸色顿时变得难看无比......
放眼望去，不下数百位龙城修士重创倒地，还有许多龙家族人亦是如此！！
大长老拖着受伤的身躯来到了龙战面前道：“族长大人！！必须得尽快让大家回族修养才行，否则只会死伤惨重，恐怕......”
“你安排人将受伤的族人还有龙城修士尽快带回去治疗。”
“凡是受伤者，全部请最好的神医医治。”
“去将隔壁的林神医请过来，无论花费多少代价都行！！”
龙战身为族长，此刻也不犹豫道。
“好的，老夫这就去安排。”
“只是，那秦风怎么办？”
“这家伙还在哀山之中，总不能就这样放弃了吧？”
“他体内可是有着我们龙家的希望啊！！”

大长老神情激动道。
“此事，不用担心，本族长自会想办法。”
“赶紧去找人将伤者带回去再说。”
“另外，先让林神医救治吾儿龙云飞，看能不能保住这小子的根基。”
话落，龙战便消失在了原地。
大长老也连忙拱手离去！！！
与此同时，凶鸟王连忙起身，感受到那股来自哀山深处的凶威消失后，不由蹙眉道：“怎么回事？那位至尊为何突然散发出了凶威？而且这股凶威之中，并无杀意和愤怒，甚至带有一丝恐惧......”
“到底发生了什么事情？难道是人皇来了？”
“不可能吧，龙战有这个本事，立马叫来人皇？？”
“可恶！！”
“该死的龙家，本王绝不会轻易放过你们龙家任何一位族人的！！！”
content_en:
Just when Qin Feng was complacent about his breakthrough.
Suddenly, a terrifying force spread out from the depths of Ai Mountain, causing many powerful beasts to kneel down and tremble.
The Fierce Bird King, who was fighting Long Zhan, did not dare to be careless. He hurriedly stopped the fight, turned around and looked towards the depths of Ai Mountain, fell to his knees, with a look of extreme fear on his face! !
"Not good!"
"It's that powerful aura. Could it be that Supreme Aishan has awakened?"
Long Zhan's expression changed drastically, he didn't dare to be careless at all, and left quickly! !
At this time, he couldn't care too much anymore. The only thought in his mind was to run away. If he was caught by the Aishan Supreme, there was no need to think too much about the consequences. He would definitely die! !
Fortunately, although this powerful force was emitted, it did not have any killing intent. Instead, it quickly disappeared.
This made Long Zhan, who had just escaped from Aishan, breathe a sigh of relief.
But when he saw the scene outside Aishan, his face suddenly became extremely ugly...
Looking around, no less than hundreds of Dragon City monks were seriously injured and fell to the ground, as were many Long Family members! !
The great elder dragged his injured body to Long Zhan and said, "Master Patriarch!! We must get everyone back to the clan to cultivate as soon as possible, otherwise there will only be heavy casualties. I'm afraid..."
"You arrange for people to bring the injured tribesmen and Longcheng monks back for treatment as soon as possible."
"Anyone who is injured should be treated by the best miraculous doctor."
"Go and invite Divine Doctor Lin next door, no matter how much it costs!!"
As the clan leader, Long Zhan said without hesitation at this moment.
"Okay, I'll make arrangements now."
"But, what should Qin Feng do?"
"This guy is still in mourning. He can't just give up, right?"
"He contains the hope of our Long family!!"
The great elder said with excitement.
"Don't worry about this matter. The leader of this clan will find a solution on his own."
"Hurry up and find someone to take the injured back."
"In addition, let Divine Doctor Lin treat my son Long Yunfei first to see if we can preserve this boy's foundation."
As soon as he finished speaking, Long Zhan disappeared from the spot.
The great elder also quickly handed over and left! ! !
At the same time, the Ferocious Bird King quickly stood up. After feeling the ominous power from the depths of Ai Mountain, he frowned and said, "What's going on? Why did the Supreme suddenly emit ominous power? And in this ominous power, there is no murderous intention or anger, and there is even a trace of fear..."
"What happened? Is the Human Emperor coming?"
"It's impossible. If Long Zhan has this ability, call the Human Emperor immediately??"
"Damn it!!"
"Damn the Long family, I will never let any of your Long family members off easily!!!"
